description: This file defines a PHP interface named BucketArnInterface within the Aws\Arn\S3 namespace, which extends another interface ArnInterface. It declares a method getBucketName() related to AWS S3 bucket ARNs.

classes.name: BucketArnInterface
classes.description: A PHP interface for AWS S3 Bucket ARNs, extending the general ArnInterface and including a method to retrieve the bucket name.

methods.name: getBucketName
methods.description: Method to retrieve the name of the S3 bucket associated with the ARN.
